verdict.rationale: GitCafe is a Git forge, so a package and container registry is a fair capability to ask about. The evidence covers repositories, pull requests, stacks, CI checks, webhooks, the API, the CLI and MCP, but never mentions a package registry or container images in any format. Private repositories and personal access tokens are adjacent features and earn no credit toward package publishing or consumption.

support.subject: As a developer, I can publish and consume public or private packages and container images in many formats such as npm, PyPI, and Maven
